title: Divide All Parts by 2
text:
$-4 < 2x \leq 8$
$\frac{-4}{2} < \frac{2x}{2} \leq \frac{8}{2}$
$-2 < x \leq 4$

Since we're dividing by a positive number, the signs don't change.

title: Convert to Interval Notation
text:
$-2 < x \leq 4$ means:
- x is greater than -2 (not including -2)
- x is less than or equal to 4 (including 4)

Interval notation: $(-2, 4]$
- Round bracket at -2 (not included)
- Square bracket at 4 (included)

title: Final Answer
text:
$-2 < x \leq 4$

Interval notation: $(-2, 4]$

On a number line: open circle at -2, closed circle at 4, shaded between.
